description: This file defines a FastAPI application with dependency injection functions and a route that uses these dependencies to extract query parameters and cookies.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Function that extracts a query parameter q which can be a string or None.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: Union[str, None] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Dependency function that retrieves the query parameter q or, if absent, falls back to the cookie last_query.

methods.name: read_query(query_or_default: str = Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor))
methods.description: Route handler that returns the extracted query or cookie as JSON.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: Union[str, None] = Cookie(default=None), )
